qa.inspection_method: Original-resolution visual inspection after every generation; final 1536x1536 workspace assets inspected with view_image original. Percent measurements are estimated against the 1254x1254 selected generation before lossless-ratio resampling.

package_master.target_comparison: pass within the locked ±2% coordinate and ±3% scale tolerances
package_master.material: pass — thick optically clear glass wall and base, plausible edge highlights/refraction, no disposable-plastic seam or rim
package_master.closure: pass after closure-only refinement — low, plain matte charcoal-black metal reading; decorative motif suppressed and plastic pebbled finish removed
package_master.identity: pass — exact direct black MORA only; no paper label, LE LABO wording, perfume grid or fragrance hardware
package_master.background_and_physics: pass — plain warm brand-ground family, coherent upper-left source and grounded down-right contact shadow

composition_master.coordinate_note: The selected generative frame is visually stronger than later position-only edits but the open-mouth top and cue x-position sit slightly outside the numeric target. Therefore the approved image, not a fresh numeric interpretation, is the authoritative overlay master. The first SKU rollout must use pixel overlay and delta correction before approval.
composition_master.usage_legibility: pass — opened product, removed seal, spooned serving and recipe cue communicate a single unambiguous consumer-use scenario
composition_master.object_count_and_separation: pass — exactly one jar, one food seal, one spoon and one combined thyme-honey cue; no overlaps or unrelated props
composition_master.material_and_identity: pass — clear heavy glass, direct MORA / THYME HONEY, no paper label, plastic tub, perfume hardware or source-brand trade dress
composition_master.background_and_physics: pass — plain warm brand-ground family with coherent soft shadows and plausible glass/metal response

release_gate: Do not generate the full SKU family until both masters are treated as immutable reference inputs.
For every SKU, attach the package master and composition master; repeat all series locks in the prompt.
Overlay the candidate against the golden image and score bbox, baseline, prop centers, background, glass response and direct-print placement.
If a check fails, edit only that causal axis and preserve every passed region.
Approve one SKU completely before starting the next SKU.
